title: 第19章 骷髅战马第20章 绿芽朝露
content_zh:
“它血量已经只剩三分之一了，这个距离足够我射杀它。”
在寒冰箭减速的三秒里，方南山连出四箭，都是没有附加灵魂碎片力量的普通攻击，他担心再次出现给敌人加血的状况，所以心里一番计算之后，便改为正常攻击。
速度没有提起来的骷髅骑士，只冲到他跟前八米处，就不甘心的倒下。
“咻！”
方南山正想松一口气，忽然一支骨箭垂射到眼前，来不及闪躲，直打在他的胸口处，顿时感觉一阵剧烈疼痛，身子不由得后退一步。
骷髅弓手原来已经追赶到攻击范围，开始对他出手。
“这一箭居然扣减我80点血，好高的攻击！”
他现在四百多的血量，被一箭射掉五分之一，确实有些吃惊，之前的战斗他也不是完美闪躲攻击，但一般被击中也只扣他十来点血，并且没什么强烈的痛感。
骨箭完成攻击之后，并没有插在他身上，直接就消失了。
他迅速调整姿势，一边跑动起来，拉开距离，一边还击。
“骷髅弓手的射击距离不如我，它只有四十米的有效射程，我有五十米以上。”方南山很快就判断出对手的射程，然后利用自己变异强弓更远一点的射程，开始风筝对手。
他现在的直弓，三十米内是高命中率的距离，五十米内是伤害不减，但命中率会有所下降，五十米之外，伤害逐渐降低，并且命中率也幅度下降，主要是对手容易闪避开来，即使是预判出手，对手也有足够时间来改变运动轨迹。
“-145”
精准命中骷髅弓手，它头上顿时冒出一个三位数，它的防御显然比骑士差得远，现在高攻高伤害的方南山，可以轻松的打掉对手差不多五分之一的血量。
后面的战斗就变得容易了，高移动速度下的风筝战术，十分轻松的把这后面一串的骷髅小队逐一射杀，这就是远程攻击的优势，如果还是使用木剑，方南山今天可能讨不了好处。
“果然还是多掌握各种攻击手段，尤其是只有自己一个人的时候，不然应付不了突发状况。”
随着最后一只骷髅枪盾兵倒下，这一次突如其来的魔将小队，终于被他全剿。
“叮！恭喜【爱吃包子】，成为寒月大陆据点第一个斩杀魔物数量达到一千的勇士，完成千魔斩成就，奖励贡献值200点，功勋值200点，名望值20点，获得正道卫士称号。”
【个人成就：千魔斩】完成对魔道生物的千次击杀，以后对所有魔道生物的伤害永久增加5%，对低级魔物具有轻微的震慑力，但同时你也更容易成为魔道生物的攻击目标，增加高级魔物对你的仇恨，它们可能突然出现，对你进行攻击，请时刻注意提防，保护自身安全。
【正道卫士】全属性+3，对魔怪伤害+3%。

“终于拿到新的称号，可以跟【灭魔先锋】进行叠加，这下又等于连升三级。”两个称号就等于五级了，虽然现在他的等级还是五，但其实真正的战斗力，肯定是远高于五级的。
千魔斩是个人成就，并不直接提升个体实力，但是能够在某一方面形成优势，也算是一种提升。
“继续刷吧，所有基础功法都提升到精通级再说。”
方南山稍作休整，便继续开杀，这次他更进一步，在六级和七级的怪物区域大开杀戒，都是枪盾兵和弓箭兵的混合，难度不小。
基础功法达到精通级后，想要提升到大师级，就有更高的要求，除了等级要达到七级，还在一些隐藏属性上有所要求，比如根骨，比如悟性，如果达不到要求，那即使经验值满溢，也是无法提升的。
解决倒也不难，商店里有提升根骨和悟性的药剂，只要你买得起，那一切问题都迎刃而解。
content_en:
"Its HP is only one-third left. This distance is enough for me to shoot it."
During the three seconds when the ice arrows slowed down, Fang Nanshan fired four arrows in a row, all of which were normal attacks without the power of soul fragments. He was worried that the situation of adding blood to the enemy would happen again, so after some calculation in his mind, he changed to normal attacks.
The Skeleton Knight, who had not increased his speed, only rushed eight meters in front of him before falling unwillingly.
"Phew!"
Fang Nanshan was about to breathe a sigh of relief when suddenly a bone arrow was shot in front of him. He had no time to dodge and hit him directly in the chest. He suddenly felt a sharp pain and he couldn't help but take a step back.
The skeleton archer had already caught up to the attack range and started to attack him.
"This arrow actually deducted 80 points of my blood. What a high attack!"
He now had more than 400 health points, but he was a little surprised when one-fifth of his health was lost with an arrow. In the previous battles, he did not dodge the attacks perfectly, but usually when he was hit, he only lost about ten points of health, and he did not feel any strong pain.
After the bone arrow completed its attack, it disappeared without being inserted into him.
He quickly adjusted his posture and started running to keep distance while fighting back.
"The shooting distance of the skeleton archer is not as good as mine. It only has an effective range of forty meters, while I have more than fifty meters." Fang Nanshan quickly judged the opponent's shooting range, and then used the longer range of his mutant bow to kite the opponent.
His current straight bow has a high hit rate within thirty meters. Within fifty meters, the damage is not reduced, but the hit rate will decrease. Beyond fifty meters, the damage gradually decreases, and the hit rate also drops significantly. The main reason is that the opponent is easy to dodge. Even if the shot is predicted, the opponent still has enough time to change the trajectory.
"-145"
Accurately hitting the skeleton archer, a three-digit number suddenly appeared on its head. Its defense was obviously far worse than that of the knight. Fang Nanshan, who now has high attack and high damage, can easily knock out almost one-fifth of the opponent's health.
The subsequent battle became easier. The kiting tactics at high movement speeds easily killed the skeleton team behind them one by one. This was the advantage of long-range attacks. If he still used the wooden sword, Fang Nanshan might not be able to get any benefits today.
"Sure enough, it is better to master various attack methods, especially when you are alone, otherwise you will not be able to cope with emergencies."
As the last skeleton gun and shield soldier fell, this time the sudden team of demon generals was finally wiped out by him.
"Ding! Congratulations to [Love Eating Buns], for becoming the first warrior to kill a thousand monsters in the Hanyue Continent stronghold. After completing the achievement of killing a thousand monsters, he will be rewarded with 200 contribution points, 200 merit points, and 20 reputation points, and he will be awarded the title of Guardian of the Righteous Path."
[Personal Achievement: Killing Thousand Demons] After completing a thousand kills against demonic creatures, the damage to all demonic creatures will be permanently increased by 5% in the future. It has a slight deterrent effect on low-level monsters, but at the same time, you are more likely to become the target of demonic creatures, increasing the hatred of high-level monsters towards you. They may suddenly appear and attack you. Please always be careful and protect your own safety.
[Righteous Guardian] All attributes +3, damage to monsters +3%.
"Finally got a new title, which can be superimposed with [Demon Slayer Vanguard]. This is equivalent to a three-level upgrade in a row." The two titles are equivalent to level five. Although his level is still five now, his real combat power must be much higher than level five.
Killing Thousand Demons is a personal achievement and does not directly improve individual strength, but it can be regarded as an improvement if it can form an advantage in a certain aspect.
"Continue to practice until all basic skills are upgraded to the proficiency level."
Fang Nanshan took a short rest and then continued to kill. This time he went a step further and started killing monsters in the sixth and seventh level monster areas. They were all a mixture of gun shield soldiers and archers, which was quite difficult.
BaseAfter the skill reaches the proficiency level, if you want to upgrade to the master level, there are higher requirements. In addition to reaching level seven, there are also requirements on some hidden attributes, such as root and bone, such as understanding. If the requirements are not met, even if the experience value is overflowing, it will not be improved.
It's not difficult to solve it. There are potions in the store that can improve your abilities and understanding. As long as you can afford it, all problems will be solved.
